requirement_text: Users shall be able to select a session based on the FACET and the tool they wish to use.
user_story: As a user, I want to select a session by FACET and the tool I wish to use, so that I join the right session.
technical_task: Provide session selection based on the FACET and on the tool the user wishes to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a FACET and a tool, when the user selects them, then the matching session is offered.
Given the matching session, when the user selects it, then the session is joined.

requirement_text: Access to the transmit queues shall be controlled within the communication service primitives .
requirement_text_raw: Access to the transmit queues shall (3.3.6.8) be controlled within the communication service primitives .
user_story: As a software developer, I want access to the transmit queues controlled inside the communication service primitives, so that queues are used safely.
technical_task: Control all access to the transmit queues within the communication service primitives.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transmit queue, when a task accesses it, then the access goes through the communication service primitives.
Given a direct access attempt outside the primitives, when it is made, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "controlled within".

requirement_text: System shall provide search functionality based on criteria such as person, type of crime, modus operandi, etc.
user_story: As an investigator, I want to search by person, type of crime, modus operandi and other criteria, so that I can find related cases.
technical_task: Provide search that supports criteria such as person, type of crime and modus operandi, and further criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person, a type of crime or a modus operandi, when the investigator searches, then matching records are shown.
Given another supported criterion, when the investigator searches, then matching records are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: investigator. "Etc." means other criteria may exist but none is named.

requirement_text: The irregular activity reports are customizable.
user_story: As a user, I want to customize the irregular activity reports, so that they show what I need.
technical_task: Make the irregular activity reports customizable.
acceptance_criteria: Given an irregular activity report, when the user changes its settings, then the report reflects them.
Given customized settings, when the report is opened again, then the settings still apply.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The customizable elements are not listed.

requirement_text: A user shall be able to select a payment method and complete the payment.
user_story: As a customer, I want to choose a payment method and complete the payment, so that I can buy.
technical_task: Provide payment method selection followed by payment completion.
acceptance_criteria: Given the payment methods, when the user selects one, then it is chosen for the payment.
Given a chosen payment method, when the user completes the payment, then the payment is processed.

requirement_text: The system shall provide progress indicators during the cloning process.
user_story: As a user, I want progress indicators while cloning runs, so that I know how far it has come.
technical_task: Show progress indicators during the cloning process.
acceptance_criteria: Given the cloning process is running, when the user looks at the screen, then a progress indicator is displayed.
Given the cloning process finishes, when it completes, then the progress indicator shows completion.

requirement_text: Remark: The front panels could differ in design, size, surface, different number of pushbuttons, several controls...
rationale: The sentence is a remark listing possible differences and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a remark about front panel variants?
What must the system do for different front panel designs?

requirement_text: THEN effective TSA speed limit shall be updated earliest 200 milliseconds before and no later than when the EV is passing the speed limit sign associated with exit ramp.
user_story: As a driver, I want the effective TSA speed limit updated near the exit ramp sign, so that I see the right limit.
technical_task: Update the effective TSA speed limit no earlier than 200 milliseconds before and no later than the time the EV passes the speed limit sign associated with the exit ramp.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EV approaching the sign of the exit ramp, when it is more than 200 milliseconds before the EV passes, then the effective TSA speed limit is not yet updated.
Given the EV passes the speed limit sign associated with the exit ramp, when the update is made, then it is not later than the moment of passing.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. The leading "THEN" suggests an omitted condition; none is invented.

requirement_text: The system shall allow publishers to configure clients for data package publishing.
user_story: As a publisher, I want to configure clients for data package publishing, so that publishing works with my tools.
technical_task: Provide configuration of clients that publish data packages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a client, when the publisher configures it for data package publishing, then the configuration is saved.
Given a configured client, when a data package is published, then the client uses the configuration.

requirement_text: This interface shall be closely discussed with daimler MetaCore responsible and should be agreed by MetaCore responsible from OEM.
rationale: The sentence describes a discussion and agreement process and states no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Who is the MetaCore responsible and which interface is meant?
What must the interface do and by when must agreement be reached?

requirement_text: All user sessions involving financial transactions or sensitive data are encrypted using SSL/HTTPS.
user_story: As a customer, I want sessions with financial transactions or sensitive data encrypted with SSL/HTTPS, so that my data is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt every user session that involves financial transactions or sensitive data using SSL/HTTPS.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session with a financial transaction, when it runs, then it is encrypted using SSL/HTTPS.
Given a session with sensitive data, when it runs, then it is encrypted using SSL/HTTPS.

requirement_text: User shall sign up or sign in using their email ID and password.
user_story: As a user, I want to sign up or sign in with my email ID and password, so that I can access my account.
technical_task: Support sign up and sign in using an email ID and a password.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email ID and a password, when the user signs up, then an account is created.
Given a registered email ID and its password, when the user signs in, then access is granted.

requirement_text: Time Services shall provide a utility timer to the application. Note that this timer is not voted, and must be assigned to a variable defined using non-congruent memory.
requirement_text_raw: Time Services shall [SRS246] provide a utility timer to the application.  Note that this timer is not voted, and must be assigned to a variable defined using non-congruent memory.
user_story: As a software developer, I want Time Services to give the application a utility timer that is not voted and sits in non-congruent memory, so that I use it correctly.
technical_task: Provide a utility timer from Time Services to the application, unvoted, and assign it to a variable defined in non-congruent memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when it asks Time Services for time, then a utility timer is provided.
Given the utility timer, when it is used, then it is not voted and is held in a variable defined using non-congruent memory.

requirement_text: An API User shall be able to normalize measures by geographical area.
user_story: As an API user, I want to normalize measures by geographical area, so that areas can be compared.
technical_task: Offer an API function that normalizes measures by geographical area.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measure and a geographical area, when the API user requests normalization, then the normalized value is returned.
Given measures for different areas, when they are normalized, then they are comparable.

requirement_text: The patient chooses 'My Diagnoses" and is presented with a listing of all their own diagnoses sorted by diagnosis date (more recent first).
requirement_text_raw: The patient chooses 'My Diagnoses" and is presented with a listing of all their own diagnoses  sorted by diagnosis date (more recent first).
user_story: As a patient, I want to see all my own diagnoses sorted by date with the most recent first, so that I find the latest quickly.
technical_task: Show the patient a list of all their own diagnoses sorted by diagnosis date in descending order when 'My Diagnoses' is chosen.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient chooses 'My Diagnoses', when the list is displayed, then all of the patient's own diagnoses are listed.
Given the list of diagnoses, when it is displayed, then it is sorted by diagnosis date with the more recent first.

requirement_text: System shall allow administrator to block any service by entering the name or selecting from a list.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to block a service by typing its name or choosing it from a list, so that it can no longer be used.
technical_task: Allow blocking of a service by entering its name or by selecting it from a list.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service name entered by the administrator, when the block is confirmed, then the service is blocked.
Given a service chosen from a list, when the block is confirmed, then the service is blocked.

requirement_text: System shall ensure the application loads quickly on supported devices.
rationale: "Quickly" is not measurable and the supported devices are not listed.
clarification_questions: How long may the application take to load on a supported device?

requirement_text: System shall accommodate a large volume of items and users without encountering faults.
rationale: "Large volume" and "without faults" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: How many items and users count as a "large volume"?

requirement_text: Adobe Illustrator shall not be installed on a volume with a case-sensitive file system.
user_story: As an IT administrator, I want Adobe Illustrator not installed on a case-sensitive file system volume, so that it runs correctly.
technical_task: Prevent the installation of Adobe Illustrator on a volume that uses a case-sensitive file system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a volume with a case-sensitive file system, when the user installs Adobe Illustrator on it, then the installation is not allowed.
Given a volume without a case-sensitive file system, when the user installs Adobe Illustrator, then the installation is allowed.

requirement_text: The BE shall send output data to the e2e System.
user_story: As a systems integrator, I want the BE to send its output data to the e2e System, so that downstream processing receives it.
technical_task: Send the output data of the BE to the e2e System.
acceptance_criteria: Given the BE has output data, when it is produced, then it is sent to the e2e System.
Given the e2e System, when it receives data, then it comes from the BE.

requirement_text: User shall be able to interact with the registration window for entering customer details and registering new customers.
user_story: As a staff member, I want a registration window to enter customer details and register new customers, so that customers are on record.
technical_task: Provide a registration window for entering customer details and registering a new customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration window, when the user enters customer details and confirms, then a new customer is registered.
Given the registration window, when details are missing, then the customer is not registered.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to refine their search directly on the same page if their initial search yields no results.
user_story: As a user, I want to refine my search on the same page when it returns nothing, so that I do not start over.
technical_task: Offer search refinement on the same page when the initial search yields no results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search with no results, when the results page is displayed, then the user can refine the search on the same page.
Given a refined search, when the user submits it, then results for the refined search are shown on that page.

requirement_text: The date time patient identification and user identification must be recorded when electronic health information is created modified accessed or deleted; and an indication of which action(s) occurred and by whom must also be recorded.
requirement_text_raw: The date  time  patient identification  and user identification must be recorded when electronic health information is created  modified  accessed  or deleted; and an indication of which action(s) occurred and by whom must also be recorded.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the date, time, patient ID, user ID and action recorded whenever electronic health information is created, modified, accessed or deleted, so that every access is auditable.
technical_task: Record the date, the time, the patient identification and the user identification, together with an indication of which action occurred and by whom, when electronic health information is created, modified, accessed or deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information is created, modified, accessed or deleted, when the action happens, then the date, time, patient identification and user identification are recorded.
Given a recorded entry, when it is read, then it shows which action occurred and by whom.

requirement_text: The system shall operate efficiently and respond to user actions within a reasonable timeframe.
clarification_questions: What response time counts as "reasonable" and for which actions?

requirement_text: The patient selects the relevant physical services he is interested in and is then presented with the top five hospitals with that experience.
requirement_text_raw: The patient selects the relevant physical services he is interested in  and is then presented with the top five hospitals with that experience.
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose the physical services I am interested in and see the top five hospitals with that experience, so that I can pick a hospital.
technical_task: List the top five hospitals with experience in the physical services that the patient selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient selects the relevant physical services, when the results are shown, then the top five hospitals with that experience are listed.
Given a selected physical service, when the results are shown, then each listed hospital has experience with it.
rationale: Role stated: patient. How "top" is ranked is not stated.

requirement_text: Admin shall have a dashboard showing usage stats and locations for insights.
user_story: As an admin, I want a dashboard with usage statistics and locations, so that I gain insight into how the system is used.
technical_task: Provide an admin dashboard that shows usage statistics and locations.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin opens the dashboard, when it is displayed, then usage statistics are shown.
Given the admin opens the dashboard, when it is displayed, then locations are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure that projected Event/Activity data is readable by 90% of viewers on a 10x10 projection screen from a 30-foot viewing distance.
user_story: As an event attendee, I want projected Event/Activity data readable from 30 feet away, so that I can read it from my seat.
technical_task: Make projected Event/Activity data readable by 90% of viewers on a 10x10 projection screen from a 30-foot viewing distance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 10x10 projection screen and a viewing distance of 30 feet, when viewers read the projected Event/Activity data, then at least 90% can read it.
Given the survey of viewers, when less than 90% can read it, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: System shall display an error message if the device is not connected to a network and terminate the application.
user_story: As a user, I want an error message when my device has no network connection, so that I know why the application closes.
technical_task: Show an error message and terminate the application when the device is not connected to a network.
acceptance_criteria: Given the device is not connected to a network, when the application starts, then an error message is displayed.
Given the error message was displayed, when the user acknowledges it, then the application terminates.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create new forms with various question types (e.g., multiple choice, Likert scale).
user_story: As a form author, I want to create forms with different question types such as multiple choice and Likert scale, so that I can collect varied answers.
technical_task: Allow creating new forms with several question types, for example multiple choice and Likert scale.
acceptance_criteria: Given the form builder, when the user adds a multiple choice question, then it is part of the form.
Given the form builder, when the user adds a Likert scale question, then it is part of the form.

requirement_text: When an event occurs, the THEMAS system shall identify the event type and format an appropriate event message.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want THEMAS to recognise the type of each event and build a matching event message, so that the right message goes out.
technical_task: Identify the event type when an event occurs and format an event message appropriate to that type.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event occurs, when THEMAS processes it, then the event type is identified.
Given the event type, when THEMAS builds the message, then an appropriate event message is formatted.

requirement_text: During billing mode, the app shall represent cash payment for items ordered.
user_story: As a waiter, I want the app to show cash payment for the ordered items in billing mode, so that I can settle the table.
technical_task: Represent cash payment for the ordered items in the billing mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given the billing mode, when the bill is shown, then cash payment is represented for the ordered items.
Given ordered items, when cash payment is chosen, then the items are included in the payment.

requirement_text: All three edge points shall be equal to the reference point if the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want all three edge points set equal to the reference point when the object is smaller than the required accuracy, so that tiny objects are not over-described.
technical_task: Set all three edge points equal to the reference point when the extension of the object is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object whose extension is smaller than the required accuracy in x- and y-direction, when its edge points are determined, then all three equal the reference point.
Given an object whose extension is not smaller than the required accuracy, when its edge points are determined, then they are not forced to equal the reference point.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. The leading "All" is read as all three edge points.

requirement_text: The re-align function shall be allowed only when permitted by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
requirement_text_raw: The re-align function shall (3.3.8.13) be allowed only when permitted by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the re-align function allowed only when the Vehicle/Mission Manager permits it, so that alignment is controlled.
technical_task: Permit the re-align function only when the Vehicle/Mission Manager has allowed it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Vehicle/Mission Manager permits it, when the re-align function is requested, then it is allowed.
Given the Vehicle/Mission Manager does not permit it, when the re-align function is requested, then it is not allowed.

requirement_text: Adobe Creative Cloud shall offer seamless updates for Adobe Illustrator CC, ensuring users automatically receive the latest versions with new features and bug fixes.
user_story: As a designer, I want Adobe Illustrator CC updates delivered automatically through Adobe Creative Cloud, so that I always have the latest version with new features and bug fixes.
technical_task: Offer automatic updates for Adobe Illustrator CC in Adobe Creative Cloud that deliver the latest versions with new features and bug fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new version of Adobe Illustrator CC is available, when Adobe Creative Cloud checks, then the update is received automatically.
Given an installed Adobe Illustrator CC, when the update is applied, then it contains the new features and bug fixes.
rationale: Role assumed: designer. "Seamless" is not measurable and is not tested.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to request an exchange for an item they want, if the item they have is eligible for exchange.
user_story: As a user, I want to ask for an exchange for an item I want when my item is eligible, so that I can swap items.
technical_task: Allow a user to request an exchange for a wanted item when the user's own item is eligible for exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user's item is eligible for exchange, when the user requests an exchange for an item they want, then the request is sent.
Given the user's item is not eligible for exchange, when the user requests an exchange, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.
user_story: As a new user, I want to land on the login page after registering, so that I can sign in right away.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the login page after successful registration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful registration, when it completes, then the login page is shown.
Given the login page, when the user enters their credentials, then access to the application is granted.

requirement_text: Developer shall prevent duplicate transactions from being published and manage the time gap between validation and publishing decision for data integrity.
user_story: As a developer, I want duplicate transactions kept from being published and the gap between validation and publishing managed, so that data stays consistent.
technical_task: Prevent the publishing of duplicate transactions and manage the time between validation and the publishing decision.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction that duplicates an earlier one, when publishing is attempted, then it is not published.
Given a validated transaction, when the publishing decision is made, then the time gap since validation is managed.
rationale: Role stated: developer. How the gap is managed is not stated.

requirement_text: It shall be able to be installed in an Air Transportable Rack (ATR) Chassis with .8 pitch spacing card slots.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.2.3.1.2.2) be able to be installed in an Air Transportable Rack (ATR) Chassis with .8 pitch spacing card slots.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the unit to fit in an Air Transportable Rack (ATR) chassis with .8 pitch card slots, so that it can be racked.
technical_task: Make the unit installable in an Air Transportable Rack (ATR) chassis with .8 pitch spacing card slots.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ATR chassis with .8 pitch spacing card slots, when the unit is installed, then it fits.
Given the unit, when its dimensions are checked, then they match the .8 pitch card slot spacing.

requirement_text: Light My Way shall exclusively run on Android OS without cross-platform compatibility.
user_story: As an Android user, I want Light My Way to run only on Android OS, so that it is built for my platform.
technical_task: Build Light My Way for Android OS only, with no cross-platform support.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Android device, when the user installs Light My Way, then it runs.
Given a non-Android platform, when Light My Way is installed, then it is not supported.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to decline an exchange offer from another user.
user_story: As a user, I want to decline an exchange offer from another user, so that I keep my item.
technical_task: Provide a decline action for exchange offers from other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exchange offer from another user, when the user declines it, then the offer is declined.
Given a declined offer, when the exchange list is viewed, then it is no longer pending.

requirement_text: System shall detect consecutive failed login attempts.
user_story: As a security officer, I want consecutive failed login attempts detected, so that attacks can be spotted.
technical_task: Detect consecutive failed login attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given failed login attempts one after another, when they occur, then the system detects them.
Given a successful login, when it occurs, then the count of consecutive failed attempts is not continued.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The threshold is not given.

requirement_text: The HCP selects a different Lab Technician from the list of available Lab Technicians (displayed with Lab Technician specialty and the number of pending lab procedures in his or her priority queue grouped by priority).
requirement_text_raw: The HCP selects a different Lab Technician from the list of available Lab Technicians (displayed with Lab Technician specialty and the number of pending lab procedures in his or her priority queue  grouped by priority).
user_story: As an HCP, I want to choose a different Lab Technician from a list showing specialty and pending lab procedures by priority, so that I can pick the best fit.
technical_task: Let the HCP select a different Lab Technician from the list of available Lab Technicians, displaying each one's specialty and the number of pending lab procedures in their priority queue grouped by priority.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of available Lab Technicians, when the HCP opens it, then each shows its specialty and the number of pending lab procedures grouped by priority.
Given the list, when the HCP selects a different Lab Technician, then that Lab Technician is chosen.

requirement_text: An HCP chooses to view received referrals.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to view received referrals, so that I can act on them.
technical_task: Let the HCP choose to view received referrals.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP chooses to view received referrals, when the list opens, then the received referrals are shown.
Given a received referral, when it is listed, then it is available to the HCP.

requirement_text: Apple Silicon processors shall offer enhanced performance and power efficiency.
rationale: The sentence states a hardware property and no measurable target.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement on the system or a statement about the hardware?
What performance and power measures must Apple Silicon processors meet?

requirement_text: Students shall be able to participate in forums, blogs, and discussions.
user_story: As a student, I want to take part in forums, blogs and discussions, so that I can learn with others.
technical_task: Offer forums, blogs and discussions in which students can participate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a forum, a blog or a discussion, when a student opens it, then the student can participate.
Given a student's contribution, when it is submitted, then it is shown in the forum, blog or discussion.

requirement_text: The NE shall support at least 6 virtual groups.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.2.3) support at least 6 virtual groups.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE to support at least 6 virtual groups, so that enough groups can be configured.
technical_task: Support a minimum of 6 virtual groups in the NE.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NE, when 6 virtual groups are configured, then all are supported.
Given fewer than 6 virtual groups, when they are configured, then they are supported too.

requirement_text: User shall be able to handle the initial withdrawal sequence.
rationale: "Handle" and "initial withdrawal sequence" are not defined.
clarification_questions: What is the "initial withdrawal sequence" and what steps does it have?
What must the system do when the user handles it?

requirement_text: FDIR shall report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when requested to do so by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
requirement_text_raw: FDIR shall (3.3.5.3) report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when requested to do so by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want FDIR to report the total FCC status to the Vehicle/Mission Manager when it asks, so that I can see the overall state.
technical_task: Report the total FCC status from FDIR to the Vehicle/Mission Manager on request by the Vehicle/Mission Manager.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Vehicle/Mission Manager requests the FCC status, when FDIR handles the request, then it reports the total FCC status.
Given no request from the Vehicle/Mission Manager, when FDIR runs, then the report is not required.

requirement_text: User shall receive a more helpful file-level error message when uploading a file with the wrong extension.
user_story: As a user, I want a more helpful error message when I upload a file with the wrong extension, so that I can correct it.
technical_task: Show an improved file-level error message when an uploaded file has a wrong extension.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with the wrong extension, when the user uploads it, then a file-level error message is displayed.
Given the error message, when the user reads it, then it explains that the extension is wrong.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "More helpful" is read as stating the cause of the error.

requirement_text: Employers shall be able to create questions for applicants to respond to when applying.
user_story: As an employer, I want to create questions for applicants to answer when they apply, so that I can screen them.
technical_task: Provide a function for employers to create questions that applicants answer when applying.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application setup, when the employer creates a question, then it is saved.
Given an application, when the applicant applies, then the applicant is asked the employer's questions.
